paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
suggested_experiment_name: HotQCD lattice topological susceptibility (HISQ) axion cosmology
coupling_convention: T_osc in MeV (axion oscillation temperature, lower edge of 'this work' band); x-axis is f_a in GeV. Values emitted exactly as plotted on the T_osc [MeV] vs f_a [x10^12 GeV] plane.
notes: Lattice QCD calculation (HISQ, 2+1 flavor) of the topological susceptibility above Tc, used to derive a cosmological bound on the QCD axion decay constant assuming post-inflationary misalignment (theta^2 = pi^2/3) and axions saturating the dark matter abundance (Planck Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1199). Main result: f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV with ~10% uncertainty (K-factor variation shifts it by ~20%). The paper's exclusion is on the T_osc-f_a plane; no explicit m_a values are given, so the mass entry was inferred from the standard zero-temperature relation m_a ~ 5.7 ueV * (1e12 GeV / f_a). This is a cosmological/relic-abundance bound, not a haloscope search, so no local DM density assumption applies. The stated CL is not given by the paper; 0.95 used as default.
